notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» is a relation (the father is not named); the compiler's own leading number «5» is removed
The Imam «أبي عبد الله», written after «عن» inside the chain, stays narrator (owner ruling 2); «كان في خدمة أبي جعفر الثاني» describes يحيى and is not a link
«(ع)» blessings are not part of any surface
